headline: Opinion: Benches Remain One of Society's Best Technologies
dek: They require no account, no software update and almost no onboarding.
excerpt: Before commissioning another platform, city leaders should consider the humble public bench.

body.text: New Zork has embraced technology enthusiastically. Services have apps, buildings have QR codes and simple processes increasingly require creating an account.
Against this backdrop, the public bench remains a triumph of restraint.
A bench requires no tutorial. Its interface is obvious. Its core function is immediately discoverable. Users generally understand the product within seconds.
The bench may be the finest example of frictionless onboarding ever deployed.
The Editorial Board therefore encourages city officials to install more benches before approving any initiative containing the phrase "digital transformation."
